courses.name: Data Analytics for Business Capstone
courses.syllabus_body: Public showcase fixture with synthetic course content.

page.title: Analytics workflow
page.body: A business analytics workflow begins by defining the decision problem and success criteria. Students then inspect data quality, document missing values and anomalies, prepare reproducible transformations, compare suitable models, and translate validated results into an actionable business recommendation.

page.title: Data quality checklist
page.body: Check field definitions, data types, duplicate records, missingness patterns, impossible values and potential leakage before modelling. Record every decision so another team member can reproduce the analysis.

page.title: Prepare for your workshop
page.body: Before the workshop, review the supplied dataset dictionary and bring one example of a business decision that could be supported by the available variables.

assignments.name: Assignment 1
assignments.description: Individual analytics report using the supplied dataset.

assignments.name: Assignment 2
assignments.description: Group project: develop, evaluate and communicate a business analytics solution. Submit a written report, presentation video and reproducible code.

assignments.name: Assignment 3
assignments.description: Individual reflection on analytical decisions and team collaboration.
